warnings: Beam sections of sheet 6 (ขยายคาน B12-B23). All bars printed with ø → type RB (section 0.6); the sheet's own note 'ทดการเสริมเหล็กคาน' (in _view5_notes) substitutes RB15/RB19 by DB16/DB20 — recorded as printed, the substitution is not applied to these values.

'คอม้า L/5' bars (bent-up bars, bottom at mid-span) are merged into main_bar.bottom with the split kept in the note (section 7 precedent for curtailed/bent bars): e.g. B15 bottom = 3 ø25 straight + 3 ø25 bent = 6.

B12's bent-bar count digit is unclear (read 3; flagged). B13' is given only by reference ('= B13 แต่ขนาด 0.30x0.40'). B20's '3 ø19 มม. มีในคาน ตัดไป 1.00 ม.' is a curtailed top bar set — merged into main_bar.top with mixed_dia_mm.

The two stairs (บันไดด้านหลัง / บันไดด้านหน้า) carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2); their bar callouts are kept as bar_layers with the location read from the leader position (flagged). Beam elevations: B13, B15, B17 (first pass) and B23 (second op04 pass 2026-10-22) are transcribed into the elements' notes — those four are every beam elevation printed on sheet 6.
